title: Ocean Lighting Solutions
description: Business & e-commerce website for a lighting and bathware showroom in Negombo, Sri Lanka. Customers can browse LED lights and bathroom products, save favourites to a wishlist, view past projects, and contact the team by phone, WhatsApp, or quote request.

title: Azytion - Digital Solutions Company Website
description: Website for a Sri Lanka-based digital company offering software development, web design, graphic design, video editing, digital marketing, and ready-made business systems. Features service pages, ready-made products (POS, ERP, CRM, LMS), portfolio section, project cost calculator, and contact forms.

title: USGEMS - Luxury Gemstone Dealer Website
description: Elegant e-commerce website for a gemstone dealer showcasing rubies, sapphires, emeralds, and diamonds. Features collection pages with filters by gem type, product detail pages, certification and trust sections, customer reviews, and a private viewing booking flow.

title: Azdars - Digital Studio & Agency Website
description: Bold, modern agency website presenting studio services, software products (POS, inventory, finance, CRM), partnership options, FAQ section, affiliate programme, and project enquiry form with single-page navigation.

title: Zaidh Usman - Personal Portfolio Website
description: Personal branding and portfolio website introducing skills, experience, projects, education, and services. Features CV download, contact form, social links, and a fully responsive modern design.

title: Brand Identity & Graphic Design
description: Logo designs, brand identity packages, social media graphics, and marketing materials for multiple clients including Ocean Lighting Solutions, USGEMS, Azytion, Azdars, Royal Property, Property Lanka, and Zuhara. Focused on clear messages and consistent branding.
